name: Hartware MedienKunstVerein (HMKV)
funding: City of Dortmund, Kunststiftung NRW, State of North Rhine-Westphalia; non-profit art association.

name: HALLE FÜR KUNST Steiermark
funding: Province of Styria Cultural Department (Land Steiermark), Federal Ministry for Arts and Culture (BMKÖS); public foundation.

name: Grazer Kunstverein
funding: Federal arts ministry, City of Graz and Land Steiermark culture department. Patrons: AVL List, Industriellenvereinigung Steiermark, Weitzer Hotels, legero united, Weingut Peter Skoff.
records_note: Names its patrons in text and its six board members, shows public funders as logos, and posts no annual report or accounts.

name: Salzburger Kunstverein
funding: City of Salzburg, Land Salzburg, BMKÖS; artist-governed non-profit art association.
watch: Founded in 1844; housed in the 1885 Künstlerhaus Salzburg; champion of experimental international contemporary art.

name: Friart Kunsthalle Fribourg
funding: Canton of Fribourg, City and Agglomeration of Fribourg, Loterie Romande, Banque Cantonale de Fribourg, the Sandoz family foundation and the Friends association.
watch: Loterie Romande is a public lottery, no flag. Partners include the University of Fribourg and Fribourg Tourisme. No protest or censorship found.
records_note: No annual reports or accounts found; the about page names backers and partners without a date and lists the association committee.

name: CAN Centre d'art Neuchâtel
funding: City of Neuchâtel, Canton of Neuchâtel, Loterie Romande, Pro Helvetia; artist-run non-profit association.

name: Iniva (Institute of International Visual Arts)
funding: Arts Council England National Portfolio, Stuart Hall Foundation, charitable grants; registered educational charity.
watch: Founded in 1994 with Stuart Hall as founding chair; custodian of the irreplaceable Stuart Hall Library on diaspora and global art.

name: CCA Glasgow (Centre for Contemporary Arts)
funding: Creative Scotland Regular Funding, Glasgow City Council; registered educational charity.

name: Tramway
watch: Glasgow Life's 2025/26 thanks list includes Bloomberg Philanthropies; 260 UK artists asked five London theatres to drop Bloomberg in May 2026. Not targeted here.
records_note: Managed by Glasgow Life, which posts annual reviews 2013-14 to 2025-26, charity accounts, a supporters list for 2025/26 and its board.

name: CCA Derry~Londonderry
funding: Arts Council of Northern Ireland is the primary funder; Derry City and Strabane District Council, Garfield Weston Foundation and Caldwell & Robinson Solicitors are also named.
watch: Garfield Weston Foundation is graded as an ordinary trust elsewhere on the map. No controversy, protest or censorship found.
records_note: The NI register holds annual reports 2023 to 2024 and accounts to 2025; the about page names funders undated; no board list on the site.

name: Catalyst Arts
funding: Arts Council of Northern Ireland, Belfast City Council, member support; artist-run collective.

name: Ormston House
funding: The Arts Council of Ireland (An Chomhairle Ealaíon), Limerick City and County Council; non-profit cultural initiative.
watch: Co-designed cultural resource centre run by artists and curators; active River Shannon environmental research.
